task.description: Short id for the operation, e.g. vector_add, div, softmax

wrapper_name.description: Exact PyTorch wrapper function name required by TritonBench, e.g. div

imports.description: Newline-separated import lines; must include torch, triton, and triton.language as tl

kernel_code.description: Triton kernel source with @triton.jit decorator; no import lines

launcher_code.description: PyTorch wrapper function source only; must define wrapper_name; no import lines

dtype.description: Primary tensor dtype, e.g. float32, float16, bfloat16

extra.description: Operation-specific hints, e.g. axis, shapes, rounding modes

quick_test_code.description: Minimal runnable smoke test on CUDA (not included in deepbork predictions)
